transcript: My name is Atheru Weigzing, and I am an entry-level IT professional interested in a business analyst role. I practice requirements, user stories, and UAT through projects. One project was a sales dashboard for business. My work was sales reports. We faced missing data, so I helped test a solution. The final system made reporting easier.
feedback: Atheru, you provided a clear introduction, but your answer could be more structured. You gave a specific example of a project, but didn't fully explain your role in it.
strengths: You have hands-on experience with requirements, user stories, and UAT
weaknesses: Your answer could be more detailed and focused on your specific contributions to the project
suggestions: Provide more context about your role in the project
Explain how your skills align with the business analyst position
better_answer_example: For example, I was the lead business analyst on a sales dashboard project. I worked closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, created user stories, and led the UAT process. My goal was to ensure the system met the business needs and improved sales reporting.
